description: This file contains functions for interacting with devicemapper in a Linux environment, including retrieving device stats, parsing dmsetup output, and obtaining device information for Docker's devicemapper storage driver.

methods.name: GetDMStats
methods.description: Retrieves devicemapper thin provisioning statistics for a given pool name and block size.

methods.name: parseDMStatus
methods.description: Parses the output of `dmsetup status` to extract used and total device counts.

methods.name: ParseDMTable
methods.description: Parses a line of `dmsetup table` output to extract major, minor device numbers and block size.

methods.name: DockerDMDevice
methods.description: Returns information about the devicemapper device and partition used by Docker.
